name: Carman's Plaza
summary: Carman's Plaza is a neighborhood shopping center on Carmans Road in Massapequa, offering convenient retail and services to Long Island residents. With extended hours and a 4.2-star rating from over 1,400 reviews, it serves as a reliable local shopping destination.
demographics: Carman's Plaza serves the suburban Massapequa community on Long Island, attracting primarily middle to upper-middle class families with household incomes ranging from $80,000 to $150,000. The trade area draws heavily from Nassau County residents, including young families with children, working professionals, and retirees who value convenient neighborhood shopping. Typical visitors are homeowners aged 35-65 who prefer quick, accessible shopping trips for everyday needs and services rather than destination retail experiences.
description: Carman's Plaza is a neighborhood shopping center conveniently located at 941 Carmans Road in Massapequa, New York, serving the Long Island community with everyday retail and services. This accessible strip center provides local residents with a practical mix of stores and amenities for their daily shopping needs. With extended operating hours from 7:00 AM to 10:30 PM, the plaza accommodates busy schedules and offers flexibility for working families and professionals. The center has earned a solid 4.2-star rating from over 1,400 Google reviews, reflecting its consistent service to the Massapequa community. Managed by Cedar Realty Trust, Carman's Plaza represents the type of neighborhood retail hub that Long Island residents rely on for convenient, close-to-home shopping.
